title: AI data centers are becoming harder to build, and neoclouds are feeling it
lede: An Equity episode with Arizona Land Consulting CEO Anita Verma-Lallian on why AI data center projects are getting harder to finish now that Nvidia will only backstop sites close to running.

points: Nvidia has said it will not backstop a data center until it is nearly operational, as neoclouds report delays and pricier debt.
Verma-Lallian's firm assembles sites for developers, hyperscalers, AI labs and neoclouds; she argues land, power and a finished shell count for more than a pitch.
Community opposition and state-level restrictions are making some markets harder to build in.
Utilities are asking large customers such as TSMC to help pay for the infrastructure that delivers more power.
The episode covers why speculative projects may fail first in a possible 2027 shakeout, and whether labs and hyperscalers will build their own sites.
